ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and peduncle junction are solid low-intensity black. Right lobe contains high-intensity white ground with approximately 12 distinct circular/ring-shaped low-intensity blobs. Left lobe contains high-intensity white ground with dense, irregular low-intensity mottling concentrated at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary boundary. A distinct singular indentation/notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 10% from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch to the tips, while visible leading edges are convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of circular ring-like pixel patterns on the right lobe; smaller, irregular dark clusters on the left lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable small semicircular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical 'ocellus' or eye-like ring patterns localized specifically to the right ventral lobe surface.
